summary: End-to-end testing of VacAIgent (FastAPI mock backend + React light-theme frontend). Backend pytest suite (6 tests) and Playwright UI suite (16 checks) both PASS 100%. All spec items from the review request verified: happy-path itinerary generation with markdown headings/destination/origin/10-day count, 400 on end<start, 422 on missing fields, hero CTAs with smooth scroll, sample trip prefill (with date prefill), feature strip, form validation (5 inline errors), loading state with cycling phrases, results panel with rendered markdown h1/h2/h3, .md download blob, plan-another reset, error state with retry, no purple, ivory bg #FAF9F6, mobile 390px no overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Invalid date format test currently passes because Pydantic v2 returns 422 (acceptable). Native date.fromisoformat tolerates some formats; consider switching TripRequest.start_date/end_date to pydantic date type to get automatic 422 validation (instead of manual try/except 400).
Backend persists every plan to MongoDB but never reads it back; if not needed, remove the insert to reduce side effects, or add a /api/v1/trip-history GET endpoint.
/api/v1/plan-trip CORS allow_origins reads CORS_ORIGINS='*' which works with allow_credentials=True only because FastAPI normalizes — fine for mock, but tighten before production.
Frontend handleSubmit hard-codes 1400ms artificial delay even on fast responses; minor UX note — fine for elegance but consider making it conditional if real LLM latency is added later.
Date pickers use shadcn Calendar in Popover (not native browser picker) — confirmed correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are self-contained and idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend route is /api/v1/plan-trip (note /v1/). Mock backend generates deterministic markdown — assertions look for '#'/'## '/'### ', destination/origin strings, and '<N>-Day Journey' / 'Day N'. Frontend uses data-testid extensively (hero-cta-plan, hero-cta-examples, sample-trip-{amalfi|kyoto|sahara}, feature-card-{1|2|3}, planner-section, input-{origin|destination|start-date|end-date|interests}, error-{origin|destination|start-date|end-date|interests}, submit-trip-btn, loading-state, loading-phrase, results-section, results-markdown, results-download, results-replan, error-state, error-retry). To simulate backend error use page.route('**/api/v1/plan-trip', fulfill 500). Sample trip prefill sets start = today+21d, end = start + duration-1.
